title: Bacterial communities and antimicrobial resistance genes in urban wastewater treatment plants
description: Urban wastewater treatment plants are key contributors to environmental spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR). This study investigated the bacterial communities and antimicrobial resistance genes in wastewater (untreated and treated) and digested sludge (biosolids) at three urban wastewater treatment plants. Bacterial communities were characterized by 16S rRNA gene sequencing and antimicrobial resistance genes were assessed by hybrid capture-based sequencing, targeting more than 2780 unique AMR genes.
